exposure: free formula samples distributed in hospitals
cohort: 750 mothers with children under the age of 18 months in Beijing and Jinan, China
finding: Online engagement with CMF companies and exposure to promotions and discounts were associated with a lower likelihood of predominant breastfeeding, partly mediated by a more positive maternal attitude towards CMF.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was considered as a confounding factor in the analysis of the association between commercial milk formula marketing practices and breastfeeding outcomes.
